title: poa strigosa subsp. anceps
intro: Poa strigosa subsp. anceps, commonly known as the alpine meadow grass, is a subspecies of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa strigosa subsp. anceps include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
